tiers.name: Twinkle Lights
tiers.description:
- Name and logo recognition on our website.
- Thank you on screen before all Center Stage Musical performances.

tiers.name: Limelights
tiers.description:
- Benefits from the $500 level plus...
- Name and logo on our Center Stage Musical playbills.

tiers.name: Spotlights
tiers.description:
- Benefits from the $1000 level plus:
- 2 VIP tickets to a performance of your choice.
- Name and logo on Stories on Stage bookmarks and Studio Show programs.

tiers.name: Marquee Lights
tiers.description:
- Benefits from $5,000 level plus:
- 2 more VIP tickets to a performance of your choice.
- 2 VIP tickets to either a Stories on Stage or Studio Show performance.
- Inclusion in sponsor recognition display and lobby signage for all Center State Musical, Stories on Stage, or Studio Show performances.

tiers.name: Luminaries
tiers.description:
- All benefits from $10,000 plus:
- Additional tickets or program gift certificates totalling up to no more than 2% fair market value of your donation.
- Additional intangible benefits tailored to your company’s needs.
